most_similar_reason: Candidate 4 matches the target's most distinctive structural features: a divine culture-hero who is one of four sons linked to a cardinal direction, sent by a supreme god to teach humanity, who names/orders creation and is credited with inventing a writing system and other arts, while also having a trickster-like, chaotic side.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 1 has no narrative at all—no birth, journey, creation of humans, or gifts to mankind—only an abstract, non-acting symbol of an unknowable supreme principle and its iconography.
